title: Customer Segments
prompt: Who does Renni Inc. and House Phoenix serve at the TechTown pop-up — and who could we serve next semester?

title: Value Propositions
prompt: What unique value do our products (beanies, sweatshirts, t-shirts, baked goods) and our pop-up experience deliver to customers?

title: Channels
prompt: How do customers discover and buy from us? TechTown floor traffic, Instagram, word-of-mouth, peer networks.

title: Customer Relationships
prompt: How do we build trust during the pop-up and keep people engaged for Phoenix Nest and future cohorts?

title: Revenue Streams
prompt: Where does money come from — merch sales, baked goods, donations? Cross-check with /pricing and /revenue.

title: Key Resources
prompt: What people, skills, inventory, space, and assets does the pop-up actually need on the day?

title: Key Activities
prompt: What must we do well — production, marketing, setup, selling, handoff? Which are repeatable for next cohort?

title: Key Partners
prompt: Who supports the work — TechTown, Humble Oven, vendors, Renaissance staff, Renni sponsors?

title: Cost Structure
prompt: What do we spend money on — merch unit costs, baked-goods inputs, signage, labor? Reference /pricing for per-product costs.
